306	def _inner_loop_pythonpath() -> str:
307	    """Directory that must be on PYTHONPATH so `text_classification` imports."""
308	    return str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent)
309	
310	
311	def _worker_env() -> dict[str, str]:
312	    """Environment for inner-loop workers.
313	
314	    The package is not installed (`package = false`), so workers need the
315	    reference_examples directory on PYTHONPATH. Passing that through the
316	    process environment works on Windows; the Unix `env VAR=value command`
317	    prefix does not, because CreateProcess looks for an executable named env.
318	    """
319	    env = os.environ.copy()
320	    root = _inner_loop_pythonpath()
321	    previous = env.get("PYTHONPATH")
322	    env["PYTHONPATH"] = root if not previous else root + os.pathsep + previous
323	    env["PYTHONUTF8"] = "1"
324	    return env
325	
326

328	    """Return a cwd-independent command prefix for inner-loop workers."""
329	    project_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
330	    return [
331	        "uv",
332	        "run",
333	        "--project",
334	        str(project_dir),
335	        "python",
